biography: Born on the Isle of Man, Andy Priaulx’s racing journey began not on four wheels, but two. A promising motocross rider in his youth, a devastating crash at age 16 shattered his dreams of a professional career in that discipline. Undeterred, Andy channeled his competitive spirit into karting, quickly mastering the art of wheel-to-wheel combat. His raw talent caught the eye of a local BMW team owner, who offered him a drive in a BMW M3 E46 GTR. His aggressive driving style and unwavering determination turned heads during his debut season, proving he was a force to be reckoned with. Now at 25, Andy is on the cusp of breaking into the top echelon of motorsport, with the weight of expectation and the thrill of the challenge fueling his every move.
drivingStyle: Priaulx is known for his relentlessly aggressive driving style. He attacks corners with unwavering commitment, often pushing the limits of grip and control. Tire management isn't his strongest suit, as he prefers extracting maximum pace from the tires early in a stint, sometimes to the detriment of his long-run performance. Under pressure, Priaulx thrives; the more intense the situation, the sharper his focus becomes. He relishes close battles and isn't afraid to make daring overtakes.

rivalries.name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
rivalries.reason: A clash of egos and driving styles. Dubois, a veteran known for his calculated approach, views Priaulx's aggression as reckless and dangerous.

rivalries.name: Katrina Volkov
rivalries.reason: A fierce on-track rivalry stemming from a controversial incident where Priaulx forced Volkov off the track, resulting in a heated exchange and unresolved tension.

rivalries.name: Marco Bellini
rivalries.reason: Both rising stars in similar machinery, their frequent battles for position often lead to spectacular and sometimes controversial moments.

quirks: Always wears the same lucky blue socks during races, regardless of weather.
Listens to heavy metal music at full volume right up until the moment he puts on his helmet.
Has a pre-race ritual of drawing a small Isle of Man flag on his steering wheel with a dry-erase marker.
famousQuote: Second place is just the first loser. You go out there to win, or you don't go out at all.
careerHighlight: Winning the prestigious 'Tourist Trophy' race on the Isle of Man in his first year of GT racing, an emotional victory on his home soil in front of his family and friends.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final lap of the Nurburgring 24 Hours due to a mechanical failure, costing his team a certain victory.
